items.description: Hennie's Silverlakes is a pub and grill at Shop 8 in the Six Fountains Lifestyle Centre, trading as part of the wider Hennie's restaurant group. The venue operates extended hours across the week, generally opening from around 9am on most days and from 10am on Mondays, with service continuing into the evening and the kitchen typically closing earlier depending on how busy the branch is on a given night. Sundays wind down earlier, with trading generally finishing by around 5pm. The restaurant offers separate food and drinks menus alongside a dedicated "Puppies Menu" for younger diners, in keeping with the group's family-friendly approach. Golf-on-tap bookings are accepted throughout the week, though the venue's booking policy can change around major rugby and other big sporting fixtures, when demand is higher than usual. As a branch within a larger franchise network, it also runs its own seasonal promotions and events.

Heunis & Straeuli Attorneys Inc. is a specialist law firm in Alphen Park focused on conveyancing, notarial work and contractual law. Its conveyancing practice covers the registration of bonds, transfers, servitudes and sectional titles, while its contracts work spans wills, ante-nuptial contracts, lease agreements, and commercial, sales and joint venture agreements. As notary public, the firm witnesses signatures and authenticates the validity of a range of contracts, agreements and legal documents. It serves as a panel attorney for several major South African banks, including Investec Bank, ABSA Bank, Standard Bank, First National Bank and Nedbank, handling bond and transfer work on their behalf. The firm positions itself around efficient, reliable client service, and says it follows the standards and ethics set out by the Association of Pretoria Attorneys in its dealings with clients, aiming to keep clients informed from start to finish of a matter.

His & Her Hair.Co is a hair salon in Villieria offering a personal, one-on-one styling experience from initial consultation through to final styling. The salon opened in 2010, building on experience its stylist had already gained creating hair since 2004, and has built a reputation particularly for blonde and dimensional colour work, including thoughtful foiling and toning shaped around a client's hair and maintenance routine. Beyond colour, the salon offers precision cutting and reshaping, along with colour services for brunettes, reds, coppers and grey blending. Hair care is supported with professional Keune products, alongside practical advice for maintaining colour between visits. Every appointment begins with a consultation, with current services, timing and pricing managed through online booking. The salon describes itself as a quiet, relaxed space in the heart of Villieria, and shares examples of its colour and styling work on Instagram.

Hlengani Associates is a reputation management and corporate communications firm based at Highveld Techno Park in Centurion, positioning itself as a firm that helps people and organisations be seen and heard. Its service offering centres on stakeholder management, helping clients build and maintain relationships with the groups that matter most to their business, alongside digital communications work covering online and social channels. The firm also handles media relations and public relations, managing how clients are represented in the press and the wider public sphere. A further strand of its work is research and business intelligence, gathering information to inform clients' communications and stakeholder strategies. Hlengani Associates works with a range of client brands, describing itself as a leading firm in the reputation management space, and keeps subscribers updated on industry developments through its own newsletter.

Home in 1 - Mega Store Pretoria supplies furniture, decor and equipment to the events, catering and hospitality industry, describing itself as a leading supplier to this sector. Its product range includes plastic and resin chairs such as cross-back and dining chair styles, tables, linen including damask tablecloths, and outdoor furniture such as cantilever umbrellas. For catering operations it stocks disposable plate and cup sets and other disposable packaging, alongside broader catering equipment. The store also supplies tents and party goods, decor items, and artificial grass and flooring for event setups. Beyond individual products, it offers combo deals bundling commonly needed items together, and caters specifically to brand activations and promotions as well as conference and corporate events, reflecting its focus on supplying both the hospitality trade and event organisers rather than only individual households furnishing a single party.

items.description: HZN Group Inc is an accounting and tax practice in Annlin, Pretoria, offering tax planning, SARS compliance and advisory services to individuals and businesses on fixed monthly retainer plans. Its Silver Retainer, priced from roughly R2 000 to R2 500 a month, covers annual company income tax, beneficial ownership updates, CIPC annual returns, directors' personal income tax and compensation submissions. The Gold Retainer, from about R2 500 to R3 500 a month, builds on this with monthly payslips, SARS PAYE submissions, EMP501 submissions and IRP5s, plus monthly reporting. Its top-tier Platinum Retainer, from roughly R3 500 a month, adds VAT calculations and submissions along with annual financial statements and management statements. The firm frames its offering around optimising tax efficiency, keeping clients compliant with South African revenue regulations, and providing ongoing monthly advisory insight rather than one-off engagements.

items.description: IBO-DATA (PTY) LTD, based in Heatherview, Pretoria North, supplies complete photo ID card issuance solutions. Its offering centres on PVC card printers paired with VISUAL CARD PLUS card design software, along with the consumables needed to keep them running. The company supplies a full range of printable PVC cards, from plain white and coloured blanks to technology cards such as magnetic stripe, RFID and Mifare types, as well as accessories including card holders, lanyards and clips. It also stocks colour ribbons compatible with Evolis, Fargo and Entrust PVC card printers, covering the ongoing consumable needs of organisations that have already invested in card printing hardware. Together, this range of consumables and card stock makes IBO-DATA a convenient supplier for organisations that want to design, print and issue their own staff, membership or access cards in-house.

items.description: Imbeu Development and Project Management (Pty) Ltd is a wholly black-owned consulting project management firm based in Die Hoewes, Centurion. Its name derives from the Nguni word "imbewu", meaning a seed, reflecting the firm's focus on building projects from the ground up for both private and public sector clients. The company's services span project management, programme management and construction management, alongside development management and cost management for projects in the built environment. It also offers energy efficiency and renewables consulting, and provides turnkey solutions covering a project from concept through to completion. Among its listed project experience is work carried out for the Department of Public Works. The firm positions itself around diversified professional services, with capacity drawn from a team of experienced built-environment professionals managing projects for clients across South Africa.

Incomar is a bespoke aerospace and defence engineering company based in Centurion, providing customised solutions for clients' aerospace and defence requirements. The company's work is organised around three core capability areas: engineering capabilities, flight operations and turnkey solutions, covering a project's full lifecycle from concept and design through deployment, testing, maintenance and ongoing support. Its flight operations are carried out by a team that includes operationally qualified experimental test pilots, supporting the testing and validation of engineered systems. Incomar positions itself as operating with agility and ingenuity, drawing on a highly skilled engineering team and vast industry experience to meet aerospace and defence requirements with what it describes as integrity and meticulous attention to detail, from initial concept through to deployment and ongoing client support.

items.description: Innaesim is a software engineering firm in Wapadrand that builds custom software, automation workflows and hosting infrastructure for growing businesses. Its work centres on Java-based backend development, paired with automation designed to reduce manual work and operational friction for clients. The company also builds dashboards for reporting and provides hosting infrastructure and deployment oversight, treating ongoing monitoring as part of the product rather than an afterthought. A further focus is payment integration, including mapping payment webhooks through to audit logs so that transactions can be tracked and verified. Innaesim describes its infrastructure approach as aiming for a 99.95% stability target across its live services, hosting nodes and payment systems. Taken together, the firm positions itself as a single engineering partner covering software, automation and the underlying hosting and payment infrastructure that keeps systems running in production.

Insigno Business Ent is a marketing and creative agency serving clients in the greater Pretoria area. Its creative offering covers branding, web design, graphic design, social media creatives and motion graphics and video production, giving clients a single source for visual and digital content. On the marketing side, the agency develops digital marketing strategies and content, supporting clients' online presence and audience engagement. It also supports events work, and extends into physical goods through printing services and stationery and merchandising, allowing it to produce branded print and promotional items alongside its digital creative output. This combination of digital creative, marketing strategy and physical branded goods positions Insigno as a broad-based marketing partner for small and medium businesses in the area.

Intelligent Outcomes is a specialised risk management division of Trusted SA, based in Monument Park, established in 2006 to provide products and services aimed at crime prevention and risk management. In 2015 the company expanded into asset tracking, adding recovery services and 24/7 control room monitoring to its offering. Its core specialism is covert asset tracking, where tracking devices are built directly into electronic equipment and disguised as part of the stock itself, making them difficult to detect in the event of theft. Beyond tracking, the company offers risk analysis and management services, drawing on information gathering and exchange as well as statistical analysis to help clients understand and reduce their exposure to crime-related risk, combining modular products into solutions tailored to individual client needs.

International Granite Company - Pretoria, based in Eldo Lakes Estate, Centurion, supplies cut-to-size granite and engineered quartz surfaces directly to homeowners. Its granite range is pre-cut to a standard 2m by 0.6m size in 30mm kitchen-top thickness, and is available in eight colours, including Black, Dark Grey, Dark Pink, Light Grey, Light Pink, Nut Brown, Peach Red and Mahogany Mist. Alongside granite, the company offers Swiss Performance Quartz, an engineered stone sold in standard slabs of 1.4m by 3m in either 20mm or 30mm thickness, across a range of 21 colours spanning starry blues, browns, blacks, greys and creams through to whites such as Cloudy White, Pure White and Bianco Calacutta. The business also offers a sintered stone collection as a further surface option, and backs its products with a warranty, positioning its ranges as a cost-effective, low-maintenance alternative for kitchen and other high-traffic surfaces.

Iso Build Trailer Manufacturers Pretoria, based in Tileba, designs and builds customised trailers for businesses across South Africa, drawing on more than 15 years of experience in the trade. Rather than offering off-the-shelf trailers, the company custom-designs each unit to a client's exact specifications, with options including utility and flatbed trailers, livestock trailers, refrigerated units, food trailers and diesel bowsers. Trailers are built from high-grade South African steel and manufactured to SABS and SANS compliance standards, with the relevant certificates included so that completed trailers can be registered without delay. The company positions itself as a single point of contact covering design, manufacturing, delivery and ongoing modifications or service, aiming to spare clients the difficulty of coordinating multiple suppliers for a compliant, purpose-built trailer, with finished units delivered nationwide across South Africa.

iST (Integrators of Systems Technology) (Pty) Ltd, based in The Willows, is a systems integrator serving customers across Sub-Saharan Africa, including power utilities, mining, and industrial and commercial organisations. Its end-to-end solutions span advanced and smart metering infrastructure, fibre planning, and geospatial network inventory management, alongside mobile workforce and asset management systems. On the power infrastructure side, the company works in protection and control, substation automation, transformer monitoring and diagnostics, and DC power systems, serving the core needs of utility and heavy-industry clients. The company is also working on integrating a 700W hydrogen fuel cell into its product offering, pointing to emerging work in hydrogen fuel cell technology alongside its established metering and automation business, built on partnerships it says bring the best of the world to Africa.

IT Support & Training (ITST), based in Rietvalleirand, has over 30 years of experience helping clients resolve everyday technology problems. Its services cover internet and networking support, including setting up new routers and Wi-Fi or troubleshooting existing connections, alongside notebook and PC repairs such as fitting SSD drives to give older machines a new lease of life. The company also supports printers, fixing common printing problems and installing printers across different brands at client premises. Beyond hardware, ITST offers website design and hosting for small businesses needing an online presence, along with general software support for clients experiencing problems with their programs or settings. It also assists with smart phone setup and data transfers, positioning itself as a single point of contact for everyday technology issues in home and small business settings.

J. Elektries is an electrical and solar services company that has operated since 2002, based on Lavender Road in Annlin. Its solar division covers solar panel installations, inverter solutions to convert solar power into usable electricity, and battery systems for storing excess energy for backup power. On the residential side, the company handles home electrical repairs and troubleshooting, lighting design and installation, and safety upgrades such as the installation of surge protectors to help protect a household's wiring and appliances. For commercial clients, J. Elektries offers energy-efficient LED lighting upgrades, along with electrical system maintenance through regular inspections and power upgrades to meet growing business demands. Over more than two decades in the trade, the company has built up experience across both intricate electrical installations and more recent solar projects.

JH Computing Pretoria, based in Wingate Park, offers a range of technology services built around small business and individual client needs. Its managed IT service provides ongoing monthly business support, including scheduled remote and on-site assistance, preventative maintenance and device management for companies that want predictable technology support rather than one-off call-outs. The company also designs websites and provides web and email hosting, alongside domain management, for businesses needing an online presence. On the hardware side, it carries out laptop and desktop diagnostics, repairs, hardware upgrades and performance improvements, offers data recovery assistance, and builds custom PCs for gaming and work use with compatible component upgrades. Its networking service covers business network installation, Wi-Fi optimisation, cabling and secure connectivity. JH Computing also runs an online store selling computing products and accessories.

Konig Coffee, based in Wingate Park, supplies barista-style coffee machines and freshly roasted beans through its own roastery. The company says it has spent over two decades refining its coffee, focusing on a flavour that performs consistently not just in a tasting room but in the demands of busy offices, cafes and guesthouses. It pairs its machines with its own beans, aiming to deliver reliable barista-style coffee in both corporate and home settings. Konig Coffee operates a national distribution network across South Africa through a dedicated franchise model, meaning clients are supported by local partners familiar with their specific region rather than dealing with a single distant supplier. The business also supplies vending products for corporate offices and hospitality venues, extending its offering from machines and beans into the ongoing consumables that commercial coffee operations need.

Kalahari Bitumen & Emulsions, based in Boekenhoutskloof, supplies bitumen and emulsion products for road construction and maintenance projects across South Africa. Its product range includes bitumen binders such as cold mix bitumen and bitumen emulsion, along with specific grades like SS60 bitumen, aimed at providing the foundational materials road builders need for lasting surfaces. Beyond raw bitumen products, the company offers services including cold mix asphalt and asphalt paving, as well as pothole repair work, positioning it as a supplier that also supports the practical construction and repair side of road maintenance. The company says its products undergo rigorous testing to ensure consistent quality and performance. Kalahari Bitumen & Emulsions also exports its products beyond South Africa's borders to other countries in the Southern African Development Community region.

Kale Developments, based in Irene Farm Villages, Centurion, provides turnkey design-and-build property development services, taking projects from land acquisition and professional appointments through feasibility studies, financial structuring, funding, construction and final close-out. The company is a subsidiary of the Tri-Star Group Holdings, and works across commercial, residential and industrial development. Its commercial project experience includes the Centurion Square office development, the Tri-Star Group's own head office, and the Quattro Fontane development. On the residential side, it has worked on Park Street in Hatfield, The Village in Centurion and The Paddocks in Fourways, while its industrial portfolio includes a project known as The Stables, with further industrial projects reported to be in the pipeline. Kale Developments positions its core offering as a comprehensive development management service, handling the full lifecycle of a development under one roof.

Kealeboga Projects PTY LTD is a small electrical contracting business serving The Orchards and surrounding parts of Pretoria Noord, working as both an electrical contractor and a solar technician. According to its profile on the Snupit services marketplace, the company has been operating for around eight years and runs with a small team of three employees, consistent with a locally focused contractor rather than a larger firm. Its profile is listed as both background-checked and professionally verified on the Snupit platform, alongside project photos and cost information tracked through that service, pointing to an established track record of completed electrical and solar jobs in the area. Combining standard electrical contracting with solar technician work gives Kealeboga Projects a dual skill set, letting it serve clients who need either general electrical maintenance or solar-related installation and support from a single, long-standing local provider.

Keno Consulting Group (KCG), based in Montana Park, provides IT consulting and digital transformation services to South African enterprises and government agencies. The firm's work is built around helping organisations replace manual processes, outdated spreadsheets and disconnected tools with modern, centralised digital systems. Its business applications work includes designing and implementing systems such as ERP and CRM platforms, inventory management systems, finance and accounting tools, HR systems, booking platforms and reporting dashboards, often tailored to a client's specific industry. Beyond individual applications, KCG offers broader services spanning workflow platforms, cloud infrastructure, data and AI services, and cybersecurity controls, aiming to connect siloed systems, protect sensitive data and turn raw information into useful intelligence through specialist delivery teams that automate manual work across functions such as approvals and billing.

Kharitanganyise General Services (KGS) (Pty) Ltd is a South African black-owned company based in Salvokop, Pretoria, founded in 2014. The company undertakes both small and large-scale projects for government departments, private sector clients and individuals, structuring its business so that it does not limit the scope of the work it is prepared to take on. Its service lines span construction services and cleaning services, together with the supply of office equipment and furniture. KGS also offers equipment hire, events and decor services, and landscaping, giving it a broad general-services portfolio rather than a single specialism. The company frames its approach around reliability, honesty and integrity in delivery, and around pricing, product quality and delivery time as the factors it sees as determining a general services business's long-term survival.

Kievits Kroon Gauteng Wine Estate, in Kameeldrift East, is a luxury country hotel and wine estate built around Cape Dutch-style architecture and set along a Jacaranda-lined lane on a 16-hectare property. Marketed as "the Winelands in Gauteng", the estate sits around ten minutes from central Pretoria and roughly 45 minutes from Sandton, making it accessible for both weekend guests and corporate visitors seeking a nearby retreat from city life. It offers luxury accommodation, several dining venues, a wellness spa, and conferencing and event facilities, including a dedicated conference centre, with immaculate gardens forming part of the setting. The estate was named the winner of three titles at the 2025 World Luxury Hotel Awards, recognised as the Best Luxury Country Hotel in Africa, the Best Luxury Conference & Event Hotel in Southern Africa, and the Best Luxury Spa Hotel in Africa.

Kohde, based in Southdowns, Centurion, is a software development company offering custom software, application modernisation, UX design, and data and AI solutions, along with cloud services, application support and DevOps and developer enablement. Its work spans auditing and securing existing systems as well as building new ones, giving clients a view of system risk and performance alongside new development work. The company's published case studies include work for Table Charm Direct, a multi-level marketing company under the Bounty Brands Group specialising in tableware, personal care, cosmetics, fragrances, fashion wear and health products, as well as a digital transformation project for Afgri Logistics, which serves South African farmers across their full cycle of farming needs. Kohde has also worked with Axiz, a technology distributor under Alviva Holdings serving clients across 15 countries, on a unified digital commerce transformation.

Kopanong Technologies, based in Amberfield Glen, Centurion, offers ICT consulting services covering server configuration, network maintenance and broader digital and internet solutions, alongside the supply of ICT hardware and products. The company says it specialises in building future-proof IT infrastructure optimised for scalability, performance and security, aiming to serve as a long-term ICT partner rather than a one-off hardware supplier. Its data centre and facility solutions include ISO container-based builds, storage solutions and dedicated cooling solutions, catering to clients needing containerised or purpose-built data centre capacity. The company also supplies UPS backup power management for keeping systems running through power interruptions, and extends into residential solar and off-grid or backup solar power solutions, giving it a combined offering spanning traditional ICT infrastructure and power and energy continuity solutions for its clients.

Kwikbuild Cement, based in Bergtuin, Silverton, was founded in 2011 by five partners who established the company's very first blending plant in Silverton, Pretoria East. That location was chosen specifically to serve an initial target market covering Mamelodi, Pretoria East, KwaMhlanga and Bronkhorstspruit. Since then, the company has grown its reach across the wider Gauteng region and into Mpumalanga and Limpopo, and has opened a second blending plant in Kya Sands, Johannesburg, which allows it to additionally service client markets in the North-West and Free State, as well as the northern, western and eastern suburbs of Gauteng. The company's slogan, "Siyakha Nawe", meaning "we build with you", reflects what it describes as a people-focused approach built on fostering close relationships with its clients, who it serves through its cement blending operations.

Laerskool Monumentpark is an Afrikaans-medium primary school in Monument Park, affectionately known to its community as "Monnie" or "Monnies". The school caters to Grade R through Grade 7 pupils, based on its own enrolment categories for Grade R, Grade 1 and Grades 2 to 7. Its stated vision is to be a school of excellence through outstanding teaching and upbringing, pursuing high standards across academics, culture and sport rather than focusing on any single area. To support this vision, the school emphasises high moral values, active parent and community participation, the recruitment, training and retention of quality staff, and ongoing curriculum development, alongside professional management of the school as a whole. The school presents itself as aiming not simply for fixed achievement benchmarks, but for continuous improvement measured against its own past performance.

Laerskool Theresapark is a parallel-medium public primary school in Theresapark, teaching in both English and Afrikaans from its site at the corner of Hartebees Avenue and Leguan Road. The school is classified as a Quintile 5, fee-paying institution under South Africa's school funding system, meaning it is eligible to receive only a limited government subsidy, of up to roughly R204 per learner, with the balance of its running costs covered through fees set by the school's own administration. As a public school, its admissions follow the structure set out in the South African Schools Act of 1996, under which children between the ages of 7 and 15 must attend school; registration for the following academic year typically runs between April and October, with parents required to submit documents such as birth certificates and immunisation records, and additional documentation for non-South African citizens. The school operates on weekdays from 07:00 to 14:00.

Lantis Electronics supplies audio accessories and electronic components to customers across South Africa, including students and professionals. Its audio range covers items such as turntable belts, slipmats, phono cartridges and styluses, alongside headphones, microphones, speakers, phono preamps and megaphones, serving both hobbyist and semi-professional audio needs. On the electronics side, the company stocks Arduino-compatible development boards, modules and shields, breakout boards, and components such as SMD diodes, ICs, transistors and resistors, aimed at students, hobbyists and professionals working on electronics projects. It also carries measurement equipment, including analogue and digital multimeters and oscilloscopes, rounding out its offering for anyone building, testing or repairing electronic circuits. Lantis Electronics operates as an online retailer, allowing customers nationwide to order from its catalogue, with its physical base in the Garsfontein area of Pretoria.

LaundroTech, based in Valhalla, supplies commercial laundry equipment to businesses across South Africa and the wider African market. The company supplies world-leading laundry brands, including Miele and Oasis, and offers financing options to help clients acquire equipment. Its service extends beyond equipment supply to turnkey laundry projects, covering everything from initial design through to installation, along with after-sales support and maintenance to keep machines running reliably. LaundroTech also serves specialised markets such as marine wet cleaning, alongside tailored solutions for laundries in other industries and facility types. A further part of its offering is smart, cashless payment systems for laundries, designed to be reliable and portable. The company positions its overall value proposition around helping laundry operators reduce water, electricity and labour costs while improving hygiene and service quality.

Lawnitex, based in Heuweloord, Centurion, supplies and installs instant lawn, priced transparently per square metre, across Gauteng. Customers can choose between LM grass, Kikuyu grass or artificial grass depending on whether they want a softer, more luxurious lawn, a hardy family-friendly option, or a low-maintenance alternative that avoids ongoing watering and mowing. The company operates largely through online ordering, allowing customers to get instant pricing and place an order without needing a separate quote, with Lawnitex then handling delivery, installation and aftercare. Beyond lawn itself, it supplies lawn dressing and compost and topsoil to help establish and maintain healthy grass. Lawnitex also delivers dry firewood across Gauteng and nearby provinces, offering a choice of Blue Gum, Black Wattle or Sekelbos wood, all cleaned, pre-packed and ready to burn, giving the business a seasonal product line alongside its core lawn supply and installation work.

items.description: LegalDev, based in Val de Grace, is a web development company that works exclusively with law firms, building digital tools tailored to the legal profession's specific needs. Its core offerings include law firm websites, client portals, and case management systems designed around the particular workflows and regulatory requirements that apply to legal practices. The company emphasises a user-centric approach to design, prioritising intuitive navigation and responsive layouts intended to engage visitors and build trust in a firm's online presence. Given the sensitivity of legal client information, LegalDev also places a specific focus on security, saying it employs current security protocols and best practices to protect client data and other digital assets from cyber threats. Alongside its development work, the company also offers search engine optimisation and content marketing services aimed at helping law firms build their online visibility.

items.description: Lera Holdings (Pty) Ltd is a Black-owned South African company based in Hesteapark, Akasia, incorporated in 2013 under registration number 2013/126031/07. The company is registered with the CIDB and NHBRC, reflecting its standing to take on formal construction and civil engineering work, and operates across construction, building and civil engineering projects, plant hire, and an additional Elite Services offering. Lera Holdings frames its objectives around promoting a culture of service delivery, empowering women and youth in line with government policy priorities, and reducing unemployment and poverty in the communities where it works. Its stated core values include professionalism, ethical business practice, teamwork, delivering value to clients, quality and honesty, alongside a stated focus on completing work on time, with a long-term goal of becoming a significant player in national infrastructure and economic development.

Levites Treefelling, based in Riviera, provides tree felling and related garden tree services across Pretoria and the wider Gauteng area. Its core services include tree felling and cutting, branch removal, tree trimming, palm tree trimming, and stump removal, covering most of the routine work involved in managing and removing trees on residential and commercial properties. The company markets itself as a trusted local operator, built on a team it describes as professional and experienced, with felling work carried out with an emphasis on doing the job safely given the property risk involved. Levites Treefelling also says it plants trees as well as removing them, aiming to help balance tree removal with new planting for the local ecosystem. The company lists service coverage across numerous Pretoria-area neighbourhoods, including Centurion, Mamelodi, Garsfontein, Silverton, Lynnwood, Arcadia, Constantia Park and Waterkloof.

Liminal Research Consult, based in La Montagne, offers quantitative and qualitative research consulting services to academic and corporate clients. On the quantitative side, clients can book online hourly consultations with a statistician, access e-learning courses hosted on platforms such as Udemy, and attend face-to-face or online workshops delivered via tools including MS Teams, Zoom and Blackboard, covering the research process from data processing through to statistical analysis and reporting. The firm supports common statistical programming environments, including SAS, SAS JMP, SPSS and R. A parallel qualitative offering provides similar online consultations with a qualitative research specialist, along with ATLAS.ti training services for researchers using that software for qualitative analysis. The company says it provides tailored support spanning business data analysis for corporate clients through to academic collaborations with university research projects.

Look Up Solar, based in Constantia Park, is a PV GreenCard qualified solar installer specialising in residential solar photovoltaic electrical systems. The company offers personalised service to its customers and backs its installations with notable warranties, covering panels for 25 years, batteries for 10 years and inverters for 2 years. Before moving into solar, the business's installer spent a decade working in the coal mining industry as a millwright artisan, a background the company cites as part of its motivation for shifting toward cleaner, renewable power generation. Look Up Solar positions its offering around addressing load shedding, framing solar power as a practical way for South African households to reduce reliance on Eskom, and offers hybrid systems that can use Eskom power as a backup source when solar generation is insufficient. Packages are tailored to each customer's specific needs and budget.

Louie Daniele Diamond Co, trading from the Lynnwood Bridge shopping centre in Lynnwood Manor, specialises in custom-made diamond and bridal jewellery. Its current collection, named Versailles and inspired by the Gardens of Versailles, spans engagement and wedding pieces including halo and solitaire ring styles and matching stud earrings, alongside further pieces planned for the range. Beyond new jewellery, the business offers jewellery remodelling, letting clients rework existing pieces, as well as diamond viewing, jewellery care and cleaning, jewellery repairs and watch battery replacement as ongoing aftercare services. The company says it sources conflict-free diamonds and fair trade metal, and supports the Rocks of Hope Foundation as part of its approach to sourcing. Customers can visit its physical showroom or buy online, with the business offering free shipping, a 14-day return period, and a diamond upgrade option, alongside its own warranty on completed pieces.

Lugisani Development Projects, based in Celtisdal, Centurion, is one of two subsidiaries making up the Lugisani Holdings group of companies, with the business itself focused on sustainable facilities management solutions. Its sister company within the group, Lugisani Integrated Safety Solutions, handles health and safety work separately, meaning the two services sit under the same holding structure but are delivered as distinct offerings rather than a single combined service. The group's name, "Lugisani", translates as "fix it", reflecting a stated philosophy of bringing practical solutions to clients and aiming to deliver the customer experience they want. Being grouped alongside a dedicated health and safety specialist gives Lugisani Development Projects a readily available partner for clients whose facilities management needs also touch on workplace health and safety compliance, broadening the support available to its clients beyond facilities management alone.

M V Makelaars CC, operating under Authorised Financial Services Provider licence 11843 as MV Brokers, was founded in 1997 as an independent family insurance brokerage specialising in short-term insurance, and life and medical cover. Over nearly three decades the business has grown from its original family-run model into an operation with a head office in the City of Tshwane and a presence recorded at Woodhill Golf Estate, alongside branches in Hoedspruit and Paarl and representation in De Aar, while still being described as retaining the intimate characteristics of a family business. With a small team of between two and ten employees, the brokerage takes a holistic approach to financial planning, aiming to help clients protect their assets and livelihood while working toward financial independence ahead of retirement, drawing on long-standing relationships with multiple financial institutions to source tailored products for its clients.
